name: Get paginated count of segment
description: Call this when you need to know the total number of contacts that match a segment query without retrieving the actual contacts. Use the segment list retrieval endpoint instead when you need the contact data itself.

fe_query.description: Frontend query object defining filter criteria for the segment.

searchBy.description: Optional free‑text search applied to the segment.

cache_ready.description: Indicates whether the count was served from a ready cache.

count.description: Total number of contacts matching the segment query.
